ops:
After all we've
meant to each other...

...you wouldn't think of leaving
without paying us?

The bearer bonds on that
Lear Jet were forged,

I needed them destroyed so
that TWP wouldn't realize...

And you can't pay us
a nickel... can you, Walters?

I'm sorry. You know
the rules.

If word gets around Istanbul that
we don't settle with debtors,

Hey, let's not let business get in
the way of friendship.

Let's not let your head get in the way
of a bullet. Pay up.

Okay, okay, I'm way out of my
league here.
